name: Coahuila

standard.note: Coahuila's new plates from the 2025-2027 replating carry a QR code you can scan to confirm the plate is real, plus a color-shifting security pattern.

plates.title: Current design (2025)
plates.fact: Coahuila's new plates from the 2025-2027 replating carry a QR code you can scan to confirm the plate is real, plus a color-shifting security pattern.

plates.title: Electric and hybrid vehicles (green leaf)
plates.fact: Electric and hybrid cars in Coahuila can get a plate with a green leaf in the upper-right corner, and 3,880 sets went out in early 2025.

plates.title: Drivers with disabilities
plates.source: https://www.google.com/search?q=placas+coahuila+2025+replaqueo+nuevas+placas&udm=2 (news image of the 2025 plate set, A Tiempo.TV, showing a wheelchair-symbol plate)

notes: No official Coahuila (coahuila.gob.mx / pagafacil.gob.mx) page with plate pictures turned up. The official replating release (https://coahuila.gob.mx/noticias/index/atiende-gobierno-estatal-alta-demanda-en-replaqueo-y-pago-de-derechos-de-control-vehicular-03-01-25) has no plate image. News photos show a white plate with a blue 'COAHUILA' header. It's not confirmed whether the previous (pre-2025) design is still legal. A Dec 2024 report said it would expire at the end of 2024, but replating runs through 2027. The disability plate is seen only in a news image.
